platform: macOS arm64, Qt 6.11.2, Vulkan via MoltenVK

findings.evidence: Question IDs and semantic labels determine answers; array order does not. The Qt probe selects the matched option index, and duplicate or ambiguous matches fail.

Qt already rejects fractional IDs. A new test exposed 2^63 comparing equal to INT64_MAX through JSON numeric equality; two conversion sentinels now reject it while preserving the full int64 range and adjacent IDs above 2^53.
The complete encoded envelope is checked before State::respond. A 16-question oversized answer is rejected without token consumption; corrected answers reuse that token.
Observer::decide true means locally queued, not delivered or resolved. Delivery uncertainty requires explicit reconciliation and never automatic retransmission.

Mirror same-epoch request omissions into adapter retirement bookkeeping before installing the authoritative replacement. Late live and snapshot replay no longer recreates hidden details or consumes their budget.
Discovery replay is cleared when reconciliation starts. The fixture now sends ephemeral attention before its classification metadata and still binds and reconciles only the persistent thread.
Fake source disconnect reports a missing client instead of dereferencing null.
Added 200 valid frames in one burst to cross the 128-frame budget and an oversized unterminated upgrade-header rejection.
Reject --codex with --ui-preview consistently, both with and without an explicit program.
Use direct cstdint and variant includes; remove unused utility.
Remove redundant second JSON serialization while retaining parse/equality loss detection and decode-side canonicality checks.
Independent, annotated v6 golden bytes establish minimal snapshot and decision layouts before malformed-payload offset cases.

outside_diff.evidence: Scope the no-turn CLI fixture separately from qualified Milestone 2 attention and update the historical Milestone 1 handoff.
